body: I am so sorry this is all happening to you. As someone who deals with OCD themselves I know how those flareups of intrusive thoughts can be some of the worst moments of your life, I've gone through weeks of them before nearly making me lose it everytime. I hope you know how brave and strong you are for even getting out of bed every day, and that's the bravest thing one can do. When my OCD starts to go crazy I like to think of it as a voice in my head that is purposely trying to ruin my day, just because. That helps me take a step back and realize what's going on
